notes.title: Small Update 6/14
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope you are enjoying Raia Nova.

There was a small additional update addressing some issues noticed after the update on 5/31.

In the cosmetic screen some UI elements are now hidden as intended.

Enemy grapple problems fixed.

The title screen and music sequence were modified.

The "Merganser" skill needed to be changed, so it was reworked to shoot a second projectile if you have Slayer's Mead or Wishmaker's Tears active, potentially doing double damage.

notes.title: Raia Nova - The Illusion Update
notes.content:
We are back. This update adds missions, rewards, skills, items, enemies, and cosmetics.
Aside from the changes below, throughout the game stats, rewards, bosses, and abilities were balanced and adjusted. There are too many small improvements to list.

This is called the Illusion update because of the illusion cosmetic items. But there are a lot of things in this update. New Missions with new enemies. In "The Sage's Domain" there are are 2 new missions, Reverse Chasm and Mystery Jungle. They are difficult and grant an achievement. 
Cobalt Hook - Gives you an attack that can pull you to enemies.
Nether Font Belt - Makes Healing Font cause Nether Font.
Tempest Belt - Changes the Tempest Ball skill.
A new reward can be earned in the Endgame, Illusion capsules. 
They can let you make your character into Wolf, Poison Imp, Grace, or Dhalia. This includes voice and some animations.
To use one, follow this example for Wolf.
Get "Design of Wolf" from an achievement. Get an Illusion Capsule from an achievement or buying one from Vita. Combine them in the Mod Machine. Open the cosmetic panel and right click the new cosmetic. The Mod Machine and Cosmetic areas are accessed by going to a Hub and pressing G.

Evalor's voice and animation was improved/redone.
Blitz's Ultra range increased, Mothball Shell takes reduced damage from Earth to compensate.
Storm Axe buffed a little.
Blackpool and Radiate damage reduced.
Tempest Ball made more useful, reworked, new synergy with Tempest Belt.
Onyx Skin damage increased.
Bugs involving ladders and mounts fixed.
More "Yellows" (items with Rarity 2 found more often).
Needletail and some similar skills have a bigger projectile now.
Move input for Warp to Base and Mounts now cancels them on Gamepads.
Shattered Dreams was adjusted and now causes an effect on the Swing skill.
In "Data" the "failed" stat is fixed to work as desired, only a few levels can trigger it though.
Fixed some bosses randomly standing still.
Improved the projectile patterns for Dhalia and Grace's Ultra attacks.
Any enemy who shoots "Iceball" casts it slower now. It was too undodgable.
Shell skills would sometimes get stronger when used more, this is fixed.
Fate Tether now works with Pyrotech Torch and some other Ring skills. Sound fixed.
Fixed mouse size issues when game initializes
Arches (the endgame gates) show when a mission is complete.

I'm really happy with how this game and this update turned out. I am definitely still wanting to hear user feedback, comments and questions are welcome. You can use the website for contact options: raianova.net

notes.title: Here's the Latest
notes.content:
Raia Nova will be receiving a lot more changes, expect new content next patch, not just adjustments. But with a patch that rolled out yesterday (3/10) or earlier , here's what's changed.
Latest Patch:

 Fate Seal and Tether part of the descriptions were switched.
 Builder's Brace Enhancer name was changed and it now applies when a Rush skill is used not a Burst SKill.
 Hollow Scythe now applies a buff, buff stats adjusted.
 For Ice Rose the condition it causes was changed.
 Pitir now sells more items, but not items that are (exactly) the same as one you have.
 Pyrotech Barrier length changed from 5 meters to 9. It was changed to fire damage.
 Wishmaker's Tears and similar buffs now apply to more things (more Plague and Poison damage among others).
 Change to Krin that caused back clothing problems reverted.
 Krin animations and clothing adjusted.
 Dias animations adjusted.
 Tomb of the Spectre must be played to complete the region (there is a shortcut to the boss there), and Sky House 2 is not mandatory.
 Now shows no suggested mission on Region 6 and later, as intended.
 Plague was way too good, it's damage was reduced. Even so it remains one of the easiest builds on Mothball and Krin because applying it is easy.
 Fire Shard is an enhancer that does Fire damage per hit. It was adjusted to work in builds that have very rapid hits (up to 10 per second). Example: Mage Bullet, Fire Shard, Triplicate, Frenzy Spikes, Poisoner (Poison is reduced but it's still viable), Body Bound, and build Skill Speed on the Rune Tree.
 Plasma Pool adjusted to shoot faster, and visual effect improved.
 Corruption - Now does bonus damage on enemies for the Enhancer Strength Scaling of the skill.
 Ally Skills (Bee etc.) - More health, longer cooldown, and an icon related problem was fixed.


Many more small changes and fixes have been implemented. For example Animation issues with the character Krin have been fixed, and the character select screen has been improved greatly. Many changes to Endgame mission balance and rewards have been made.

notes.title: An update on the Release Date and Progress
notes.content:
Raia Nova has come a long way and the decision has been made to push back the release date to February 18th 2025. We are working on end game challenges and some changes to Rune Trees and Skills that require extra time. The game will release with crafting and end game items that were never in any version before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594936/ba57c532e08e354077042d3b0b305f112b9547a5.png


Raia Nova features classic ARPG gameplay with equipable spells and difficult bosses. Enhancers exist to power up your favorite skills and the rune tree is there to progress and customize your character. There are 5 playable characters; Krin the Spellsword, Mothball the Magician, Basa the Gladiator, Dias the Thief, and Dweller the Warden. This is a single palyer game, the game's platform is Windows, on Steam.

notes.title: The Rise of... (Steam Next Fest and update)
notes.content:
Raia Nova has recently gotten another big update, applying to both the demo and Beta versions. Most of the update is just fleshing out what was needed for many aspects of the game, so you may not notice right away. More skills were added and many tweaked and improved. Many bosses were improved and some things like animations and icons further built upon. The Story aspect has a bit more to it.

And now, it's Steam Next Fest! Celebrate by checking out all the upcoming games. We have a demo too. When will Raia Nova be released? Within a few months, more to follow.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594936/ee75b15b4be0ccb198e5a1249d49404a23151d37.png
